senses.gloss:
Raudrī
(‘the terrible goddess’)
------------------------------------------
An aspect of the goddess पार्वती, she is the feminine counterpart or consort of शिव as रुद्र (= the Terrible). She is also called Caramamuṇḍā, चामुण्डा, महामाया, Sarvabhūta-mahāraudrī and Kālarātrī.
The demon Durga, the son of Ruru, had obtained a boon that he could never be killed by male beings. Unable to bear his atrocities, all the gods approached ब्रह्मा, the creator for succour. On his request रौद्री killed Durga.
She is also described as one of the eight forms of पराशक्ति (Pārvatī as the Supreme Power) like Vāmā, ज्येष्ठा, Kālī and so on. She is the personified aspect of fire element in च्रेअतिओन्.
Iconographical works picture her as black in complexion, clad in red garments.
